name: DPHARMA
recent: Duopharma 在 2026 年 11 月 17 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的季度业绩，多家媒体报道其第三季净利按年上升 24%。公司同期有一项重大诉讼公告，以及雇员公积金局（EPF）的股权变动申报。
notable: 公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩，媒体报导第三季净利按年上升 24%。
公告一项重大诉讼（MATERIAL LITIGATION）。
雇员公积金局（EPF）在 11 月 11 日至 13 日期间连续申报股权变动。
risks: 公司有一项重大诉讼正在进行中。
EPF 在数日内连续申报股权变动，显示大股东持股出现调整。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，营收为 RM234.356 million，按季下降 5.5%，按年上升 5.7%；净利为 RM29.869 million，按季下降 2.7%，按年上升 47.8%；净利率为 12.7%，高于上一季度的 12.4%。

recent_en: Duopharma released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 17 November 2026, with multiple media reports noting a 24% year-on-year rise in third-quarter net profit. The company also had a material litigation announcement and EPF shareholding changes during the period.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026; media reported a 24% year-on-year rise in third-quarter net profit.
The Employees Provident Fund Board (EPF) filed consecutive shareholding change notices between 11 and 13 November.
risks_en: The company has an ongoing material litigation.
EPF filed consecutive shareholding change notices within a few days, indicating adjustments in major shareholder holdings.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM234.356 million, down 5.5% quarter-on-quarter but up 5.7% year-on-year; net income was RM29.869 million, down 2.7% quarter-on-quarter but up 47.8% year-on-year; net margin was 12.7%, higher than 12.4% in the previous quarter.
